name: Edwin Pringle
bioAdditions: FamilySearch confirms Edwin (b. about 1841) in James Pringle's household in 1850 and 1860 (S1). It also has a separate profile for an Edward Pringle (b. 11 Aug 1843, d. 16 Dec 1917 at Retreat, Luzerne Co.), who married Amanda Dodson, lived in Plymouth in 1870 and 1880, and is buried in the Scott Cemetery, Huntington Twp, which was the Scott family's burial ground (S2). That profile carries an 1850 census entry too. 'Edwin' and 'Edward' may be one man; the burial among the Scotts fits a son of this family. The 1917 Pennsylvania death certificate would settle it.
